messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

Transfer only the hairstyle shape and structure from the references; do not adopt the reference person's facial features, hair color, or clothing. Preserve the person's existing hair color and all other elements of the current video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please select the video where the person has black hair, then use that video as the starting point for the following change: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please restyle the person's hair according to the reference images. Only transfer the hairstyle from the reference images, not the reference person's facial features, hair color, or clothing. Preserve everything else in the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands with her back to the camera, initially still, then shifts her weight and places her hands on her hips before lowering them again.","camera":"The camera is positioned behind the character at a medium distance, slowly pulling back to reveal her full body and the surrounding environment.","clothing":"She wears a short, white romper with a floral pattern of pink and yellow flowers and green leaves, featuring a low open back and three-quarter sleeves, along with pink flat shoes.","hair_color":"Brown.","hairstyle":"Brown hair is pulled back into two low pigtails or buns at the nape of the neck.","identity":"A female character with a slim build, seen from behind, with a medium skin tone.","scene":"The setting is an outdoor urban rooftop or plaza with a tiled floor, a metal tower structure with a loudspeaker on the left, and tall city buildings with red signage in the background under a clear sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The character's hair changed from a loose, wavy updo/bun to two low side buns/pigtails with a center part and braided sections, matching the reference structure. The hair remains brown rather than the reference's black, and the clothing, scene, pose, and camera movement appear preserved.
arguments.requested_change: Restyle the person's hair to match the reference hairstyle, transferring only shape and structure while preserving the person's existing hair color, facial features, clothing, and all other video elements.
uncertain: Whether the front bangs and exact braid details fully match the reference, since the character is mostly seen from behind.
